info.title: Sailor Moon SuperS
info.synopsis: Nella quarta serie di Sailor Moon i nuovi avversari delle guerriere sono gli artisti circensi del Dead Moon Circus, capeggiati dall’algida e bellissima regina Nehellenia, la quale, volendo liberarsi di un maleficio che la tiene costantemente imprigionata in uno specchio, mira a catturare un mistico unicorno alato chiamato Pegasus, il cui corno d’oro le garantirebbe poteri illimitati. Pegasus è il leggendario guardiano dei sogni dei bambini, ed è nel più puro di essi, simboleggiato da un brillante specchio dorato, che si nasconde. Compito delle guerriere, stavolta, sarà di trovarlo e proteggerlo.

episodes.title: Eclissi solare
episodes.synopsis: During a solar eclipse, a mysterious floating circus tent appears in the sky over Tokyo. Meanwhile, Chibiusa is fascinated by a Pegasus who appears to her in a dream.

episodes.title: Il potere di Pegasus
episodes.synopsis: When Reika returns from Africa, Usagi becomes concerned that she and Motoki are having relationship problems. Meanwhile, Tiger's Eye selects Reika as a target.

episodes.title: La torta della mamma
episodes.synopsis: When Ikuko is attacked by Hawk's Eye, Sailor Moon must once again rely on the mysterious Pegasus for assistance.

episodes.title: La trappola
episodes.synopsis: When Hawk's Eye announces he has designed a system to trap Pegasus, Tiger's Eye approaches Naru with the intention of using her as bait.

episodes.title: La coppia perfetta
episodes.synopsis: Chibiusa worries that Saori, a friend of Mamoru's from college, is romantically interested in him.

episodes.title: La gattina parlante
episodes.synopsis: Rumors of Artemis' interest in other women spiral out of control after a small talking kitten appears, claiming that Artemis is her father.

episodes.title: La scrittrice
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa are excited to discover that a best-selling book was written by an old friend of Makoto's.

episodes.title: Un vero amico
episodes.synopsis: Tiger's Eye targets Chibiusa's art teacher in the hopes of attacking Pegasus and finding his host.

episodes.title: Un ospite improvviso
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru moves into the Hikawa Shrine after his apartment is wrecked, so Usagi assumes the guise of a ninja to protect his honor.

episodes.title: Le fate
episodes.synopsis: Chibi-Usa befriends a young man, an artist fixated on the existence of fairies, who is targeted by Fish-eye.

episodes.title: L'auto d'epoca
episodes.synopsis: Ami befriends Mamoru's colleague Natsumi, a widow who is trying to restore a classic car.

episodes.title: La tenace spadaccina
episodes.synopsis: A young girl with dreams of being the strongest swordsman in Japan is targeted by Tiger's Eye.

episodes.title: Il sogno di moda
episodes.synopsis: Fisheye targets the fashion designer Yoshiki Usui, while Usagi hopes to persuade the designer to make her a wedding dress for free.

episodes.title: Una cocente delusione
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and the girls are shocked to find out that Minako is dating two boys at the same time, but little does anymore realize that her suitors are Tiger's Eye and Hawk's Eye.

episodes.title: Una brava cuoca
episodes.synopsis: The girls become interested in an apparently antisocial old woman after she takes Diana into her home.

episodes.title: Questione di fiducia
episodes.synopsis: Reports begin to flood in of a Pegasus wreaking havoc in the city. Meanwhile, a popular boy shows an interest in Chibiusa.

episodes.title: Sogno d'estate
episodes.synopsis: Shingo develops a crush on Ami during a trip to the beach, while Tiger's Eye plot to seduce her.

episodes.title: Stella
episodes.synopsis: Usagi begins ballet lesson in the hope of becoming a prima. Fisheye enrolls in the same class, and soon catches the eye of the instructor.

episodes.title: Sogni di una principessa
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa are befriended by a mysterious foreign woman who accompanies them to the Azabu-Juuban summer festival. Unbeknownst to them, their acquaintance is a visiting princess who is being pursed by both her government and Hawk's Eye.

episodes.title: Il ballo galeotto
episodes.synopsis: Tiger's Eye plans to seduce the girls at a university dance party, while Makoto is immediately smitten with the charming stranger.

episodes.title: La triste realtà (prima parte)
episodes.synopsis: While Fisheye targets Mamoru, Queen Nehellenia appears before the Amazon Trio and warns them that without the Golden Crystal, they will soon revert to their animal forms.

episodes.title: La triste realtà (seconda parte)
episodes.synopsis: Fisheye discovers Chibiusa communicating with Pegasus, but refuses to cooperate with Zirconia's plans. As Hawk's Eye pursues Usagi for her Dream Mirror, Zirconia decides that the Amazon Trio have outlived their usefulness.

episodes.title: Il circo
episodes.synopsis: Zirconia sends the Amazoness Quartet in search of the Golden Mirror, and their first target is Chibiusa's friend Momoko.

episodes.title: La dolce melodia
episodes.synopsis: Ami becomes deeply obsessed with a tune she found on the internet, and writes lyrics to it. Meanwhile, VesVes of the Amazoness Quartet targets the tune's composer.

episodes.title: Spirito d'emulazione
episodes.synopsis: Rei becomes a large celebrity after being featured in a magazine article, and gains a dedicated young fan called Nanako.

episodes.title: Il mal di denti
episodes.synopsis: When Usagi and ChibiUsa need to go to dentist, they try a new office which has opened in the neighborhood, but is it a trap?

episodes.title: Il litigio
episodes.synopsis: Makoto and Minako both fall for an attractive kindergarten teacher, but Minako's all-out attempts to ingratiate herself with him soon annoyed to Makoto.

episodes.title: Paura di saltare
episodes.synopsis: On the eve of his school's athletic meet, Kyuusuke worries about the box horse, the one obstacle he is unable to clear. JunJun approaches him with the intention of taking his Dream Mirror, and offers to be his coach.

episodes.title: Lo specchio della verità
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Chibiusa befriend Kamoi, a starving young artist, who is later targeted by CereCere.

episodes.title: Amicizia in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: While VesVes targets an eccentric acquaintance of Chibiusa's who is trying to make a flying machine, Chibiusa worries that Pegasus does not trust her.

episodes.title: Il segreto di Pegasus
episodes.synopsis: PallaPalla's magic causes Usagi and Chibiusa to switch ages, turning Usagi into a child and Chibiusa into a teenager. While Chibiusa is thrilled with her new body, she is distressed to discover that she can no longer call Pegasus.

episodes.title: Il segreto di Chibiusa
episodes.synopsis: As Chibiusa becomes even more enamoured of Helios, Usagi and her friends realise that she is in love, and are determined to discover the identity of her crush.

episodes.title: La festa
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her friends, along with the Amazoness Quartet, assist in the organization of a coming-of-age ceremony.

episodes.title: Nelle mani del nemico
episodes.synopsis: Intent on escaping her mirror, Queen Nehellenia causes spider webs to appear all over the city, casting it into darkness.

episodes.title: Il tendone del circo
episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Team infiltrate the Dead Moon Circus and are confronted by Zirconia.

episodes.title: Gli specchi
episodes.synopsis: After being captured by Queen Nehellenia, Sailor Chibi Moon confronts the evil queen.

episodes.title: Il cristallo d'oro
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia forces Helios to return to his body and give up the Golden Crystal, allowing the evil queen to break free from her mirror.

episodes.title: Il superpotere supremo
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia, free from her mirror at last, prepares to use the power of the Golden Crystal.

episodes.title: La vittoria dei sogni
episodes.synopsis: Queen Nehellenia makes a desperate last stand as the Golden Crystal destroys the Dead Moon Circus.

info.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
info.synopsis: Sebbene Yu Ayase sia il figlio di un'attrice famosa e talentuosa, si rivela un ragazzo sotto la media in tutto quello che fa. L'unica cosa che sembra aver ereditato dalla propria madre è il suo bel aspetto. Quando Yu si iscrive alle superiori finisce per essere affidato a un'amica della madre e si trasferisce a casa della famiglia Mikadono. Qui farà conoscenza delle tre sorelle dotate di bellezza e talento, che frequentano la sua stessa scuola. Il ragazzo inizia a pensare che sia impossibile raggiungere un rapporto tra una persona normale e delle persone con talento, però le sorelle inizieranno a sorprenderlo con il loro carattere inaspettato...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Yu Ayase transfers to a school for prodigies—but despite his gifted mother, he's perfectly mediocre.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Tasked with looking out for the sisters, Yu tries to win them over—through their stomachs.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Yu begins to get to know the three sisters, and they start to see him as more than just an unwelcome guest.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Yu carries out his plan to have the sisters enjoy the Cherry Blossom Night Festival together.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The three sisters grow closer after the festival... and then their father comes home.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: As Kazuki prepares for her most challenging role yet, she asks Yu on a date to get in the mindset.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 優と三姉妹の前に現れたのは、高校空手界のトップ巌山高校のエースにして主将――天才空手家・龍巳ハヤト。ハヤトは二琥に会うなり、「二琥、迎えに来たぞ」と告げる。意味が分からず「！？」となる優。ハヤトは二琥と同じ道場の先輩で、二琥を引き抜きに来たのだと言う。巌山高校は全寮制。今の生活を失いたくない二琥は即答できずに困惑する。優に対して、精一杯の決意で「……一緒に、いたいんだ」と告げる二琥だが……。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Yu throws himself into intense training with Niko's help, preparing for his one-on-one showdown with Hayato.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Niko wins the battle against Hayato, so she says to Yu “I’ll grant you any wish” for doing his best for her.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Yu delivers Miwa's forgotten lunch during her shogi game. Touched, she asks him to have lunch with her.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Kazuki and Niko try to console Miwa, but she gets angry and runs out of the house. Yu goes to look for her.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Miwa faces off against Sakura now imbued with focus and determination.

info.title: Wind Breaker (ITA)
info.synopsis: La Fuurin è una scuola nota per avere gli studenti con i peggiori rendimenti scolastici e i combattenti più forti in circolazione. Volendo diventare il più forte di tutti e venire considerato alla stregua di un eroe, Sakura Haruka si unisce a un gruppo nato per proteggere la città.

episodes.title: Sakura e il Furin
episodes.synopsis: An admirer of strong people with a complete disinterest in the weak, Haruka Sakura, a loner and delinquent high school student, aims to be a fighter at the top of Furin High School. Coming from outside the city, Sakura enrolls in Furin High School, infamous for its delinquents.

episodes.title: L'eroe che ammiro
episodes.synopsis: It is the morning of the school entrance ceremony, and Furin High School has transformed into a group that protects the town now known as the "Chime of the Wind Breaker" — Bofurin.

episodes.title: Colui che ha raggiunto la vetta
episodes.synopsis:
Furin High School's first-year Class 1 is infamous for its group of strong fighters.

One of the students in the class, Kyotaro Sugishita, becomes furious with what Sakura said and throws a punch at him. The two begin a spectacular fight, ignoring an aloof Hayato Suo, who's carefully watching the fight, and Nirei, who's now panicking.

A tremendously loud voice echoes throughout the school, interrupting the fight between the two young men. The owner of that voice that instantly changed the mood of the entire school is none other than Umemiya, the Representative of Bofurin. Sakura and the rest look nervously up at the speakers to hear Umemiya say something completely unexpected.

episodes.title: Scontro
episodes.synopsis: A fight breaks out between Bofurin and Shishitoren as Bofurin tries to protect the town's middle schoolers. Sakura receives a declaration of war from the group's second-in-command, Jo Togame. Sakura and one of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Toma Hiragi, tell Umemiya what happened.

episodes.title: L'uomo dal cuore tenero
episodes.synopsis: "That’s why I'm going to take all of Furin…and you for myself!" declares Shishitoren's leader, Choji Tomiyama, as he makes his way onto Furin High School grounds. Finally, it's a one-on-one showdown between Bofurin and Shishitoren!

episodes.title: Seguire le sue orme
episodes.synopsis: Tomiyama and Togame, far from worrying about their teammate who lost the battle, expel him from their team. While this peculiar spectacle shakes Sakura and the rest, Suo becomes unexpectedly emotional and wins against Minoru Kanuma, earning another win for Bofurin.

episodes.title: Una sfida da vincere
episodes.synopsis: It’s now time for the battle of those second-in-command: Sakura versus Togame — a fight that will set things on fire!

episodes.title: Eredita quei pensieri
episodes.synopsis: Togame can no longer hide the fact he's feeling lost. He remembers when he met Tomiyama, the fun days he had with Shishitoren, how the team changed when Tomiyama became the leader, and the things he's done himself.

episodes.title: Lo stile Umemiya
episodes.synopsis: It's now time for a one-on-one fight between Umemiya and Tomiyama. Tomiyama believed that by winning against Umemiya, he would obtain Furin High School, freedom, and a sense of fun that would rival no other.

episodes.title: Conversazione
episodes.synopsis: Admitting defeat, Tomiyama tries to pass Shishitoren on to Umemiya — to which Umemiya declares, "Instead of taking over your team, we'll be friends!" Bofurin and Shishitoren are dumbfounded at this turn of events but talks progress, food is brought, and a celebratory afterparty starts.

episodes.title: Un nuovo amico
episodes.synopsis: With the fights against Shishitoren over, Class 1 enthusiastically welcomes Sakura, Nirei, and Suo's return. Their classmates, brimming with interest in the details of the fights, surround them, asking questions. Sakura can't hide his bashfulness.

episodes.title: Colui su cui si può contare
episodes.synopsis: Ren Kaji, Yuto Kusumi, and Takeshi Enomoto, second-year students from the Tamon Team, start their ruling on who will be Grade Captain for first-year Class 1. Suo is the first to raise his hand, immediately nominating Sakura as the other classmates vote for him one after the other.

episodes.title: Per il bene di un amico
episodes.synopsis: Sakura, Nirei, and Suo finish their meeting with Umemiya, the other members of the Four Kings, and other prominent leading figures and join up with Kiryu and Tsugeura on their way home.

info.title: Dan Doh!!
info.synopsis: Protagonista di questo anime è un ragazzo molto abile nel baseball, che sfidato dal preside della scuola a colpire la palla appoggiata al suolo. Rimane stupito dalla difficoltà dell’azione. Gli vengono così spiegati i rudimenti del golf che da quel giorno diventerà per lui un chiodo fisso. Dopo le difficoltà iniziali si dimostrerà molto dotato tanto da mettere difficoltà gente con molta più esperienza di lui. Tra le altre cose vedrà nel golf un modo per guadagnare un bel po’ e poter così rivedere sua madre…

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: ダンドー、優香、弘平の３人は同じ小学校で野球に情熱を傾けるチームメイト。 しかし校長の言葉でダンドーはゴルフに興味を持ちはじめ、校長の教え子でプロゴルファーだった新庄に出会う。新庄に弟子入りをし、練習に励むダンドー。そんなダンドーに、同じくゴルフをしている上級生・横田が因縁をつけてくる。横田や、練習場で出会った天才少年ゴルファー・風間が出場するジュニアゴルフ選手権にダンドー達は挑むのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: 熊本ジュニアゴルフ選手権大会、ダンドーのラウンドが開始される。新庄から出された条件は二つ。使うクラブは３本（６アイアン、サンドウェッジ、パター）そしてハーフ４５。その目標を胸に試合に望むダンドー。「よしっ、できるぞ！スマイルショット！」序盤からバンカーに入ったり木の根元にボールが落ちたりと波乱含みだが、それでも果敢に攻めていくダンドー。ゴルフ用語も技術も知らないダンドーだが、１打ごとにゴルフの知識を吸収して行くのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: 運も呼び込んで、ダンドーはなんとイーグルをとってしまう。そんなダンドーの好調ぶりを見て、横田は怒りをたぎらせる。そしてダンドー達をつぶそうと考え、まず同じ組の優香を標的にする。アドレスする優香の横でヤジを飛ばす横田と子分の小野。何とか平静を保とうとする優香だったが、しつこい嫌がらせに 耐え切れずに、思わず泣き出してしまう。一方ダンドーは、ジュニアの大会を勝ち進めば世界大会に出られると石神二郎から聞き、そのことを優香に報告しよ うとする。そして、優香が泣いているところを見て・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: グリーンエッジからのリカバリーショットを打つダンドー。だがダンドーは、二度もクラブをボール近くのライに叩きつけ空振りしてしまう。打ち方に迷うダンドー。その時、近くで見物していた老人が「サンドウエッジをパターのように振ってみなさい」とダンドーにアドバイスをする。老人の助言通りにボールを 打つダンドー、見事、カップに沈める。しかし、今度は横田がダンドーに対して何かをしようと画策し始め・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: ２人の手下を使い、あの手この手でダンドーを追い落とそうとする横田。しかし、ダンドーが放つスーパーショットや、優香の機転で横田の思惑は成功しない。「今度こそ」と横田の手下は、ダンドーのボールを別のボールとすり替える。それを知った二郎は、ルール違反だと知らずすり替えられたボールを打とうとするダンドーに「今までのボールを使え」と忠告する…。

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: ダンドーはトップを行く風間と一打差。風間に追いつくために、ダンドーは新庄との約束を破りドライバーを使う。ドライバーショットで谷越えを成功させ、イーグルをとるダンドー。焦る横田も谷越えを狙うが失敗してしまい、その後もミスを重ね悔し涙を流す。自分のコーチから「みっともない！やめろ！」と言われてしまう横田…。

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 決勝ラウンド・スタート。ダンドーは風間竜二と飛ばし屋の笠清也と同じ組で戦うことになる。風間には上品そうな父と母が、笠晴也には豪快な母親が応援に来ている。２人の家族を見て、ダンドーは少し寂しそうな顔をする。低く雷鳴がとどろき雨が降る、そんな状況の中、３人はそれぞれの思いを胸にグリーン上でのパット勝負を繰り広げる。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: 二番ホール、ガンガン飛ばしていく風間、清也。そのショットを見てダンドーも果敢に攻めていく。そんなダンドーの前に父親が現れる。動揺するダンドー。ダンドーの父親はなぜかゴルフを毛嫌いしていた。父親がゴルフをやめさせようとするのでは、と心配し、ダンドーはミスを重ねてしまう。そんな時、横田が忠告する。「プレー以外の悩み事を持ち込んでたんじゃ絶対に勝てねえぜ！」そんな言葉に気持ちを切り換え復活するダンドー。「見てろよ、父ちゃん！オレがどこまで本気でゴルフをやってきたかを！」

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 「このコース、どう攻めるかで、あの３人の将来が見えてくる」と村井が言う、その四番ホールをダンドーは６番アイアンでショットする。「６アイアン・・・これがこの少年の将来か。だとすれば・・・やはり、あの子は鷲になる！」ダンドー達が熱い戦いを繰り広げるその裏で、アマチュアゴルフ界を追放されたダンドーの父、茂道の過去が新庄の口から語られる。「あの子にゴルフをさせん！」という茂道。しかしダンドーは優勝すれば、父親もきっと喜んで許してくれると信じるのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: 優勝をかけた風間、清也、ダンドーの戦いは最終ホールを迎えた。１８番ホールは、コースのほぼ真ん中に大きく谷が口を開いている左曲がりのロングホール。トップを走る清也は谷越えでイーグルを狙う。一打差で追うダンドーも、清也に勝つためには同じように谷越えを狙わなければならない。「できる！谷は越えられる！」ほんの一瞬吹きあげる風を狙ってダンドーは谷越えショットに挑戦する。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: 九州ジュニアゴルフ選手権に参加するダンドー、優香、弘平の三人。そこでダンドー達は、新たなライバル達と出会う。無口のパワーヒッター大隈慎吾。ズル技を使うターチ・スオン。女子ゴルファー岩崎千春。ダンドーを目の敵にする田崎壇三・九州ゴルフ連合会長。田崎に雇われダンドーを監視する赤野拓也。慎吾、ターチ、そして赤野の三人はダンドーのゴルフの凄さに目を見張るのだが・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: 海に面した崖沿いのコースをアグレッシブに攻めるダンドー。「わざとバンカーに入れてボールを止めやがった！！」ダンドーの放ったショットは、子供と思って馬鹿にしていた赤野をも驚かせる。一方、ターチはダンドーを潰さなければ自分の勝ちはないとグリーンの芝を踏み荒らす。ラインを読めず最初のパットをしくじるダンドー。その手には村井のおじいさんがダンドーのために作ってくれたパターがあった。世界でただ１本のパター、ダンドーはそのパターに想いをはせ村井の期待に応えるべくロングパットを決める。

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: 海に落ちるところだった慎吾のゴルフバッグを、ダンドーは自らのパターを犠牲にして救う。パターを失ったショックで調子を崩すダンドー。自分のせいだと気に病む慎吾。そんな慎吾の心を晴らすようにダンドーはドライバーでのパットを決める。慎吾もその気持ちに応え、苦手なバンカーショットを克服する。全てがうまくいくように思えたそのとき、赤野の前に田崎が現れた。

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: 調子づくダンドーに苛立ちを隠せないターチ。「決闘だ、青葉っ！お互いのゴルフを賭けてな！！」喜んでその申し出を受けるダンドー。最終ホール、ダンドーに続いて林越えで勝負をかけるターチ。しかしプレッシャーに負けてミスを重ねてしまう。ダンドーの真っ直ぐな気持ちに心が揺らぎ、ズル技を使わずに勝負するターチだったが・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: 九州ジュニアゴルフ選手権・最終ラウンド。ダンドーは弘平と一緒の組で回る。パターも修理され、コースレコードを出しそうな勢いで順調にスコアを伸ばすダンドー。しかしその裏で田崎はほくそ笑んでいた。ダンドーがローカルルール違反を犯していたこと、すなわちグリーン上でドライバーを使ったことを知ったのだ…。

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: 新庄の計らいで赤野は札幌オープンに出場することに。そして新庄は赤野に提案する。それはダンドーをキャディーにつけるということだった。ちょうどその頃ダンドーは、母親が北海道にいるという話を耳にしてしまう。新庄邸に呼ばれ、赤野から誘いを受けるダンドー。母親への思いも重なりダンドーは北海道へ向かう。札幌オープン初日。ダンドーは試合のことより母親のことが気になってしまう。

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: 初日の赤野のスコアに責任を感じたダンドーは、夜通しかけてコースを調べる。その甲斐あって赤野は次第に順位を上げていく。しかし、初日最下位の影響は大きく、赤野は最終ホールでイーグルをとって２つスコアを上げることが必要だった。「風の爆発地点を狙って打って！」というダンドーの指示を正確にこなし、４００ヤードの超ロングドライブショットを決める赤野。イーグル目前、と思われたがパットを外してしまい・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: 初日最下位から１２位へと驚異的な追い上げを見せる赤野。しかし、調子のいい赤野を落とそうとする敵の言葉に惑わされ、赤野は木の上にボールを落としてしまう。後半は雨が降るから、と攻撃的ゴルフを要求するダンドーの言葉に、赤野は枝に乗ったボールを直接打つことに。「オレはこういうショットが大好きなんだよ」その言葉通り、見事なリカバリーを見せる赤野。そして、ダンドーの予測通り雨が降り始める・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: 単独３位に上った赤野は、帝王ジェイムズ・マッシュと飛ばし屋テリーの２人と最終組で回る。世界トップレベルの二人を相手に、必死に食らいついていく赤野。それはダンドーが眠らずに足で調べたコース情報の賜物だった。ついに赤野は首位の二人と並んだ。しかしその直後、ダンドーはここ数日の疲れから立ったまま眠ってしまうのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: 極度の疲労と睡眠不足で、立ったまま眠りに落ちてしまうダンドー。「ダンドーを起こさないで！」優香の悲痛な訴えを聞き、自分でクラブを持ってラウンドを回る赤野。しかし心に抱える不安を払拭できず、徐々にスコアを落としてしまう。赤野自身すらも勝利を諦めかけたそのとき、赤野の後ろにダンドーが現れた！二人でピンチを切り抜けていくダンドーと赤野。反撃ののろしが上がった。

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: 追い上げをかける赤野とダンドー。しかしその時、ささいなミスから赤野がペナルティーを犯してしまう。気付いているのは自分一人――黙っていようと思うダンドー。だが体が言うことを聞かず、ダンドーは不利になると分かっていながらもペナルティーを申告した。自己嫌悪に陥るダンドー。弱気になったダンドーに、赤野は意外な行動に出る。

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: 白熱した勝負の中、共にトップゴルファーを目指した友達を思い出す赤野。くそったれ場と呼ぶ練習場で共に技を競い合った、そんな仲間を思い出し赤野はダンドーに言う。「次からは自分のことを名前で呼べ。真の友人からは名前で呼ばれてぇんだ。お前にはその資格がある。」その言葉に応えるダンドー「拓さん！」怒涛の追撃をかける赤野とダンドー。ついに試合はマッシュと赤野の一騎打ちに。

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: １８番ホール。ダンドーの言葉を信じ、グリーン手前のバンカーに入れる赤野。マッシュもテリーも失策だと思ったが、１８番のグリーンには罠が仕掛けられていた。グリーンオンしたマッシュとテリーのボールは、グリーン上を走る突風に流されラフに。気付いていたのはダンドーだけだった。バーディーを決める赤野。しかしマッシュも気迫でボールをカップにねじ込み、勝負の行方は・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: 優勝は赤野とマッシュのプレーオフに持ち込まれる。勝負は１４番ホール。ダンドーは、やはり通常の攻めとは異なる場所に落とすよう指示する。言われた通りの場所に落とす赤野。ダンドーの意図はグリーンと太陽の位置関係。しかしダンドーは本当にその指示が妥当だったか思い悩む。ダンドーの意図を読んだジャックは、太陽の光はスイングに影響しないと勝利を確信するのだが・・・。

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: 九州ジュニアゴルフ選手権での敗北の後、世界修行に行っていた風間が帰ってきた。ダンドーに勝負を挑む風間。赤野とダンドーが辛勝した帝王ジェイムズ・マッシュと数ホールだが勝負し、彼に勝ったと言う。勝負を受けるダンドー。そのラウンドで、ダンドーは凄まじく成長した風間の実力を目の当たりにする。

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: ラウンドの前半が終わり、風間に大差をつけられてしまったダンドー。逆転するためにはもう一つも落とせない。自分の中にある全てのものを使って勝負を挑んでいくダンドー。それを見ている新庄や赤野、優香や弘平、そして熊本や九州の大会で知り合った子供たちも２人の勝負を見に来ていた。ダンドーと風間の勝負は熾烈を極め、そして結果は・・・

info.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
info.synopsis: Saku Chitose della sezione 5 è uno studente molto popolare. Nonostante venga insultato online dai ragazzi della sua scuola, è sempre circondato da amici. Yuuko Hiragi, la potenziale fidanzata, con l'aura da principessa; Yua Uchida, la ragazza che dà sempre il massimo ed è popolarissima; Haru Aomi, la stella del club di basket, piena di energie, sono solo alcune delle ragazze che gli ruotano attorno. Ma il tempo per divertirsi al massimo con tutte loro potrebbe finire quando un professore affida a Chitose il compito di riportare a scuola un certo hikikomori...

Al cacciatore di taglie Yashiro viene offerto di prendersi cura di tre giovani apprendisti. Egli accetta bramando il compenso, ma forse questo non sarà abbastanza per ripagarlo del suo nuovo destino.

info.title: Giant Gorg
info.synopsis: Il giovane Yū Tagami si reca sull'Isola Australe, emersa dal mare dieci anni prima (ma senza essere segnata nelle cartine geografiche), cercando di indagare sulla morte del padre, un professore che stava studiando questa nuova terra inesplorata e che è rimasto ucciso in circostanze misteriose. Nell'effettuare le sue ricerche Yū scoprirà che nell'isola si trovano manufatti misteriosi, mostri meccanici, alieni e robot giganti. Il giovane suo malgrado si troverà in una situazione più grande di lui e dovrà combattere contro un'organizzazione criminale nota come GAIL.

info.title: Muteking (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il protagonista della storia è Linn, un ragazzino americano di dodici anni che, nei panni dell'eroe Muteking, collabora con Takoro. Quest'ultimo è una sorta di polipo rosa alieno che si trova a San Francisco per catturare la famigerata banda della piovra, formato appunto da 4 piovre provenienti dal suo pianeta natale.

episodes.title: Uno strano aiuto sceriffo

episodes.title: Mangia e rimangia
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers create robotic chairs that force-feed people until they are too full to move. Muteking steps in to stop this strange, food-related alien scheme.

episodes.title: Il falso terremoto
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers attempt to conquer Earth through spreading disinformation, and Muteking has to counter their misinformation​.

episodes.title: Tutti al mare
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers cause a great flood by manipulating waves, and Muteking must find a way to stop the disaster.

episodes.title: L'astrologia colpisce ancora
episodes.synopsis: Muteking finds himself dealing with strange personal consultations brought on by the Kurodako Brothers’ newest plan​.

episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers disrupt a baseball game with their antics, leading to an unusual match where Muteking must intervene​.

episodes.title: Panico nella giungla
episodes.synopsis: The jungle is in chaos, and Muteking has to handle the mess caused by alien interference.

episodes.title: Operazione divertimento
episodes.synopsis: Muteking leads a playful adventure where everyone is involved in a big game orchestrated by the Kurodako Brothers.

episodes.title: L'allineamento catastrofico
episodes.synopsis: Muteking confronts a new threat in the form of an octopus that is revealed to be a powerful force from space.

episodes.title: Il pericolo tecnologico
episodes.synopsis: Muteking encounters an invasion of robots sent by the Kurodako Brothers, adding a mechanical twist to their usual alien plots.

episodes.title: Un castello affollato
episodes.synopsis: A ghostly figure appears in the Kurodako Mansion, and Muteking must investigate and stop any paranormal threats the Kurodako Brothers may be using.

episodes.title: La caccia al tesoro
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers embark on a treasure hunt, and Muteking tries to prevent them from uncovering dangerous items or power sources.

episodes.title: L'amore è più forte
episodes.synopsis: A new hero enters the scene—a female version of Muteking, adding a twist to the familiar storyline and challenging the Kurodako Brothers in unexpected ways.

episodes.title: Il letargo
episodes.synopsis: In a winter-themed episode, the Kurodako Brothers try to freeze the city, forcing Muteking to intervene amid snowy chaos.

episodes.title: La pioggia letale
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers’ latest scheme claims humans will evaporate in rain, a strange and unique plot Muteking must expose.

episodes.title: La pigrizia è una brutta cosa
episodes.synopsis: This comedic episode explores the Kurodako Brothers' latest gimmick, involving people enjoying themselves in cars with unexpected results.

episodes.title: Balla che ti passa
episodes.synopsis: In a celebratory setting, Muteking takes on the Kurodako Brothers during a festival, where dancing becomes key to thwarting their plans.

episodes.title: Il casco del perfetto secchione
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers develop a helmet they claim is perfect for mind control, and Muteking must stop them from controlling people’s minds.

episodes.title: La musica popolare
episodes.synopsis: Music returns as a theme with the Kurodako Brothers unleashing their new soundwave technology, which Muteking must counter.

episodes.title: La giungla d'asfalto
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, the Kurodako Brothers create a vast, confusing maze, trapping people inside. Muteking takes on the challenge of navigating it to rescue the captives.

episodes.title: La pietra della felicità
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers claim to have a lucky stone that grants immense power. Muteking intervenes before they can use it to control people’s minds.

episodes.title: La maratona
episodes.synopsis: Takoro, Muteking’s alien friend, joins a marathon race where the Kurodako Brothers use dirty tricks to sabotage the competition, but Muteking steps in to ensure a fair race.

episodes.title: Takoro si arruola

episodes.title: Piccolo Takoro cresce
episodes.synopsis: Takoro’s mother makes an appearance, bringing family dynamics into play as Takoro faces both familial expectations and the ongoing alien threats.

episodes.title: Una gita in barca
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers organize a boat tour with the intention of scamming tourists, and Muteking intervenes to prevent their fraudulent scheme.

episodes.title: La corsa delle lettighe
episodes.synopsis: During a local festival involving portable shrines, Muteking finds himself in the middle of a chaotic melee, battling against the Kurodako Brothers in a unique setting.

episodes.title: La corsa
episodes.synopsis: The episode features a hot-air balloon race orchestrated by the Kurodako Brothers. Muteking joins in to prevent their scheme from taking a chaotic turn.

episodes.title: I fumetti di Takoro
episodes.synopsis: Takoro decides to entertain the public with a storytelling performance, but the Kurodako Brothers have plans to turn it into a mess, and Muteking has to step in to keep order.

episodes.title: Un furto esplosivo
episodes.synopsis: In a festival of fireworks, the Kurodako Brothers attempt to control the display to create chaos in the city. Muteking must stop them before the fireworks endanger the spectators.

episodes.title: Speculazione edilizia
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers hold a "great sale" event at their mansion, luring in customers with sinister intentions. Muteking investigates to uncover their plan.

episodes.title: Un treno in... pensione
episodes.synopsis: A beloved train is set to retire, but the Kurodako Brothers plot to exploit the event. Muteking gets involved to prevent them from ruining the occasion.

episodes.title: Il mostro dello stagno
episodes.synopsis: In a beach-themed episode, the Kurodako Brothers disrupt a summer vacation spot, and Muteking must restore peace to keep everyone safe.

episodes.title: La pesca
episodes.synopsis: Takoro goes on a fishing trip that the Kurodako Brothers plan to sabotage. Muteking joins in to ensure Takoro’s safety and to foil their plans.

episodes.title: Il mantello magico
episodes.synopsis: A panda goes missing, and the Kurodako Brothers use an invisibility cloak in their latest scheme. Muteking embarks on a search to reveal the panda’s location.

episodes.title: Siamo tutti artisti
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers target a local theater, attempting to ruin a play by cutting the lights. Muteking intervenes to save the performance.

episodes.title: La fidanzata di papà
episodes.synopsis: This episode shows a softer side to the Kurodako Brothers, as they explore family themes. Muteking finds himself in an unexpected situation that reveals more about his foes.

episodes.title: Il giro delle 34 porte
episodes.synopsis: Takosak experiences his first love, creating a comedic and emotional episode that explores feelings and unexpected challenges in romance.

episodes.title: Luna amica
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers, known for their villainy, signal for help, revealing a more vulnerable side as they face an unforeseen dilemma that requires Muteking’s intervention.

episodes.title: Videogiochi
episodes.synopsis: In a game-like scenario, the Kurodako Brothers set up challenges for Muteking. This episode dives into strategy and highlights Muteking's clever tactics against the brothers’ tricky games.

episodes.title: La squadra di soccorso
episodes.synopsis: Muteking faces off against a Kurodako-created rescue squad, leading to a series of intense and humorous confrontations as he works to dismantle their latest plans.

episodes.title: La quarta dimensione
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers utilize a teleportation device to evade capture, leading Muteking on a thrilling chase filled with teleportation-induced chaos.

episodes.title: L'avventura finisce?
episodes.synopsis: In this series finale, Muteking engages in a final showdown with the Kurodako Brothers. The stakes are high as the characters confront their biggest conflict, bringing closure to the series with a climactic battle.

info.synopsis: Secondo film della trilogia di Hathaway che celebra il 40° anniversario del franchise di Gundam, e il secondo progetto nel "UC NexT 0100 Project" che affronterà il futuro della timeline dell'UC.

info.title: Paw & Palaces
info.synopsis: All'insaputa dei turisti che affollano la Città Proibita, sei gatti speciali compongono la "Guardia Imperiale dei Gatti", un'organizzazione segreta creata per proteggere i tesori nazionali. Di notte, la squadra entra nel Wuhua, la dimensione spirituale custodita nei reperti d'epoca, per difenderne le memorie storiche dalla malvagia entità demoniaca Black Owl. Tra scontri per ripristinare il corretto corso del passato, litigi e momenti di unione, i felini lottano per salvaguardare il patrimonio culturale dell'umanità.
